mintAuthority.summary: gtUSDCp has three direct immutable Morpho vault deployments; shares mint only against each chain's USDC deposits. Ethereum and Base parameter owners are 4-of-7 Gauntlet Safes, while Arbitrum uses the same seven signers at a 3-of-7 threshold.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime MetaMorpho V2 vault Ethereum (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Vault shares minted only against deposited USDC. No EIP-1967 proxy slots — vault is immutable. Owner (0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec) is the Gauntlet Safe 4/7 managing parameters only.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527215, the verified VaultV2 deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned Ethereum USDC and owner() returned Safe 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec, configured 4-of-7 with no modules or guard. The owner manages vault parameters but cannot replace the deployed bytecode.

controls.evidence: At Base block 48599296, the verified MetaMorpho deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned native Base USDC and owner() returned Safe 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0, configured 4-of-7 with no modules or guard.

review.evidence: The full three-chain inventory was checked independently: Ethereum at block 25527215, Base at block 48599296, and Arbitrum at block 483587934. Every verified direct vault had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and returned the chain-local native USDC as asset(). Ethereum owner 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec and Base owner 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0 were 4-of-7 Safes; the same Arbitrum owner address was 3-of-7. All three had no modules or guard. Owners can curate vault parameters but cannot replace vault bytecode or mint base USDC. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: each immutable MetaMorpho deployment can mint shares only against deposited native USDC; the inherited base issuer publishes monthly Deloitte reserve examinations. The latest USDC report covers May 2026, and the NYDFS list matches Circle Internet Financial, LLC. M-2 evidence review 2026-08-08: supervision and reconciliation downgraded to the wrapper-level convention (steakusdc precedent) - the coin's issuer of record is the vault curator, which no named prudential regime supervises (jurisdiction is correspondingly empty), and the deposit-only share wrapper is not a separate issuer reserve regime. Circle's NYDFS supervision and monthly Deloitte examinations are facts of the underlying USDC, credited on usdc-circle, not of this wrapper.
